tasks.label: 1. Verify NVDEC Hardware Decoders
tasks.command: nvidia-smi dmon -s u,c,v,m 1 5 && ffmpeg -hide_banner -hwaccels | grep cuda

tasks.label: 2. Export YOLOv10 to ONNX
tasks.command: python3 -c "from ultralytics import YOLO; YOLO('backend/models/yolov10x.pt').export(format='onnx', dynamic=True, opset=17, simplify=True)"
